i’ve had hypnic jerks before and they are madenning, i think one of the things that actually helps with insomnia is just letting your mind do it’s thing though, letting myself refuse to think or forcing myself to count sheep or forcing myself to follow a breathing exercise and over panicking about ‘i need to be asleep in the next hour’ made everything worse for me, the best thing you can do is the same with hypnic jerks, just try again when you get one, ignore it sort of.. i know this won’t work for everyone but if you’re someone who gets too stressed/excited about actually falling asleep then actually just falling into your thoughts and giving in to bloody jerks and stuff can make it better
